verdict.rationale: The CRA documents one sanctioned system-to-system channel: EFILE, plus ReFILE for amended T1 returns. Through it, certified tax software and enrolled electronic filers transmit returns directly to the CRA. That channel covers only return filing, though. The broad UI surface shown in the e-services pages has no documented programmatic equivalent, and that surface includes business registration in BRO, payments, document submission, responding to notices, direct deposit and authorizations. Missing for 10: API coverage for registration, payments, document submission, notices and account management; open (non-certification-gated) API access; any published API reference showing parity with the online portals.
